task.shield-wall.name: Shield wall
task.shield-wall.fact: Mars lost its magnetic field about 4 billion years ago.

minigame.oxygen-factory.instruction: Drag the CO₂ into the machine!
minigame.shield-wall.instruction: Plug the holes in the wall!
task.oxygen-factory.fact2: MOXIE made 122 grams of oxygen: what a small dog breathes in 10 hours.
task.oxygen-factory.fact3: Mars air is almost all carbon dioxide (CO₂).
task.solar-panels.fact2: In 2018 a dust storm hid the Sun and shut down the Opportunity rover.
task.solar-panels.fact3: In 2009 a gust of wind cleaned the Spirit rover's panels and gave it more power.
task.greenhouse.fact2: In 2016 some flowers almost died of mold on the Space Station, and were saved.
task.greenhouse.fact3: The first lettuce astronauts ate in space was red romaine.
task.shield-wall.fact2: In May 2024 a solar storm lit up auroras on Mars.
task.shield-wall.fact3: The Curiosity rover measures how much radiation reaches the ground on Mars.
location.jezero.why: It was a lake: the best place to learn.
location.gale.why: Lots of dust: solar panels make less energy.
location.olympus-mons.why: The tallest volcano: up there, less air blocks radiation.
location.north-pole.why: Cold and months of darkness: little energy and food.
location.valles-marineris.why: A 4,000 km canyon: everything is harder.
event.solar-storm-2024-05.name: a solar storm
event.solar-storm-2024-05.text: ☢️ Solar storm! Like the one that hit Mars in May 2024.
event.solar-storm-2017-09.name: a solar storm
event.solar-storm-2017-09.text: ☢️ Solar storm! In 2017 one doubled the radiation on Mars.
event.solar-storm-2003-10.name: a giant solar storm
event.solar-storm-2003-10.text: ☢️ Giant storm! In 2003 one broke a sensor on the Odyssey spacecraft.
event.dust-storm-2018.name: a dust storm
event.dust-storm-2018.text: ⚡ Dust storm! In 2018 one like this shut down the Opportunity rover.
event.dusty-panels-2022.name: lots of dust
event.dusty-panels-2022.text: ⚡ Dirty panels! Dust shut down the InSight lander in 2022.
event.greenhouse-mold-2016.name: mold in the greenhouse
event.greenhouse-mold-2016.text: 🥬 Mold on the plants! It really happened on the Space Station in 2016.
event.wind-cleaning-2009.name: a cleaning wind
event.wind-cleaning-2009.text: ⚡ The wind cleaned the panels! It happened to the Spirit rover in 2009.
event.first-harvest-2015.name: a harvest
event.first-harvest-2015.text: 🥬 Extra harvest! In 2015 astronauts ate their first space lettuce.

collab.lever: Hold it down together with a crewmate!
collab.saved: 🛡️ You did it together! The shield held.
task.oxygen-factory.why: Just like MOXIE on Mars: you take the oxygen (O₂) out of the CO₂ in the air.
task.solar-panels.why: Martian dust covers the panels: if you don't clean them, there's no power.
task.greenhouse.why: Without water plants dry out: on the Space Station astronauts water them.
task.shield-wall.why: Water and soil stop the Sun's radiation: that's why you used those blocks.
